title: feat(security, verify): a controlled_by_parent row with no master is written by its owner or by Modify All on the detail
body:
Fixes #30906
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #30907

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：可选主表（`required: false`）的 `controlled_by_parent` 子对象里，主表引用为空的行现在可以写了：它的属主（`owner_id`）或对该子对象有「修改全部」的人可以改、删，其他人（包括只有「查看全部」的人）一律 403；新建一条不挂主表的行直接放行，创建者就是属主；给这种行挂上主表，要对那条主记录有编辑权；把已挂的主表清空，要对原主记录有编辑权，「属主可编辑」开关不覆盖清空。链式子对象（如联系人下的备注）在联系人没挂客户时，同样按联系人的属主规则判。`os verify` 的父级写入证明同时覆盖「挂主表」和「不挂主表」两种行，`security/explain` 会说明这条属主规则。
- 为什么改：您对 #30905 的裁决「A」：没有客户的联系人是私有联系人，只属于它的属主。这是三张卡的第 2 张；第 1 张放开了声明和读，写一直是 422，这类联系人建不出来、也改不了。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽「可选主表且引用为空的行」这一类（以前一律 422），必填主表的所有答复逐字节不变；能看不等于能改，「查看全部」的人改不了别人的私有行。回滚即撤 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts` 里的 `nullMasterRowWritable`，以及 `assertControlledByParentWrite` 中 `masterId == null && rel.optional` 那一段；再看 `controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts` 末尾的真实引擎用例块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts`，预期 47 个全部通过；把 `nullMasterRowWritable` 改成恒返回 true 再跑，会红 10 个（见下文消融）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/plugin-security` — the write gate (ADR-0055 §3, step 2.8).** A row of an OPTIONAL master (`CbpRelation.optional`) whose master reference is empty used to answer `422 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` on every write. It is now judged, on every shape the gate judges:

- **Owner rule** (`nullMasterRowWritable`, new): such a row is written by its owner (`owner_id`, non-null, equal to the principal's `userId`) and by a holder of `modifyAllRecords` on its object (`PermissionEvaluator.hasSuperuserWriteBypass`). Everyone else is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, `details: { operation, object, recordId }` naming the row, leg `master_chain`. A queue row (no owner) and every row of an object without an `owner_id` column are Modify All's alone.
- **Create**: an insert (single or batch) naming no optional master is admitted; the creator becomes the owner (the platform's owner stamp). Every master a batch's rows do name is still asked.
- **Update / delete by id** of a stored null-master row: the owner rule. Step 2.7 hands a detail's ownership floor to this gate, so without it a principal who merely READS the row (View All) could write it.
- **Predicate writes** (`multi: true`): `controlledByParentPredicateWriteMasters` returns the selected null-master rows beside the masters (`CbpPredicateWriteSelection`) instead of throwing; each is judged by the owner rule, and a body naming a master is asked even when every selected row names none.
- **Setting a master** (none → M): the row's owner rule, then edit on M. **Emptying one** (M → none): the §3 walk with edit on the stored master. The `ownerMayEdit` leg steps aside for a body that empties an optional master (card item 4).
- **Chains**: a hop whose master is itself `controlled_by_parent` with an optional master of its own, left empty, ends the chain and asks the owner rule of that row (card item 5).
- **On behalf of**: both passes ask the owner rule, each of its own principal (agent, then delegator). `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` answers `allow` or `deny` / `master_chain` for such a row.
- The frozen `#9137` branch is untouched: the new block runs ahead of it and only for `rel.optional`, which none of the three frozen shapes can be (a master with no `required` derives no relation at all; `readonly`/`system` is refused by `masterNotWritable` first). A required master is answered byte for byte as before. Ownership transfer stays on `allowTransfer`.
- **`security/explain`** names the owner rule when the served check refuses a null-master record (it would otherwise narrate the refusal as an unwalkable chain).

**`@objectstack/verify` — the ADR-0054 proof.** `deriveParentWriteReachCases` marks an optional-master detail (`optionalMaster: true`, via the spec's `controlledByParentMasterOf`). `runParentWriteReachProofs` proves it in both cases: its records under a master as every detail, and a new `masters: 'none'` reach per persona where the expectation is the owner rule — edit/delete allowed iff the persona holds the verb AND (owns the record OR holds Modify All on the object); create naming no master allowed iff it holds create. A null-master record the persona cannot read is listed in `unreadableDetails`, not probed.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts`: card 1's "write gate is unchanged" block now pins the admitted insert; a new top-level block on the real engine (SQL driver, real sharing service, `member_default` floor) pins create, by-id update/delete (owner, View-All reader, Modify All, queue row, no owner column, non-reader), setting and emptying a master (with and without the opt-in), the chain hop, predicate update/delete, both on-behalf-of passes, the served member, and a required-master control. Every refusal asserts `code` + `status` + `details` and the stored row. Two explain pins for the narration.
- `packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.test.ts`: `pwr_contact` (optional master) joins the fixture; a new case proves the null-master reach per persona (View All on the detail is refused another's record, Modify All writes it, the owner writes its own); the count pins move to the measured totals.

Every negative pin was ablated: forbidden behaviour put back through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, restore proven against HEAD), suite red, restored.

| Ablation | Red |
|:---|:---|
| A1 owner rule admits everyone | 10 failed / 35 passed |
| A2 `ownerMayEdit` leg covers an emptying body | 1 (the emptying refusal) |
| A3 predicate asks the body's master only when a selected row names one | 1 |
| A4 setting a master on a null-master row asks nothing of it | 1 |
| A5 chain hop ends without the owner rule | 1 |
| A7 predicate null-master rows unjudged | 1 |
| A8 by-id null-master row unjudged | 8 |
| A9 explain without the null-master argument | 1 |
| verify A1 through `dist/` | `pwr_contact` CONTRADICTED on 2 of 64 writes |

A4's first attempt was a no-op (the tool refused it: the replacement text already occurred, so the mutation did not count as landed); it was re-run in `--delete` mode and went red. The verify ablation was built into `dist/` and checked by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` on both legs (marker present after mutate, absent after restore).

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism assumptions, measured.** (1) Step 2.7 hands the floor to the gate on every non-delegated by-id write of a `controlled_by_parent` detail (`masterGateCoversThisWrite = !delegatorSets`, `platformFloorYieldsToObjectWriteModel`): A1 shows a View-All reader's update of a row created by another principal LANDS once the owner rule is removed, so the rule has to live inside the gate. (2) `@objectstack/verify` synthesis does skip non-required relations (`seedRecord`), but every probe pinned the master explicitly, so the family produced no null-master record before this change; the new reach seeds the empty reference explicitly.
- **The refusal's leg is `master_chain`.** `ControlledByParentWriteDenialLeg` is a closed spec vocabulary and `packages/spec/**` is outside this card; `master_chain` is the leg its text already gives "a master that is itself controlled_by_parent ... has an empty master reference", and here the chain ends at the row itself. A dedicated leg would be a spec contract change.
- **Card item 3 is read fail-closed.** Setting a master on a null-master row asks the row's own owner rule first, then edit on the new master: an account editor who reads, but does not own, someone's private contact cannot adopt it. Pinned.
- A principal who cannot read a null-master row meets the read door at step 2.7 (`404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`) before the gate, as for every hidden row. Pinned.
- An insert of a null-master row on an object with no `owner_id` column is admitted (card item 2), and its creator cannot read it back: such rows are View All's to read and Modify All's to write, as card 1 reads them.
- **Prose owed elsewhere, left untouched here (outside this card's surface):** the ADR-0055 2026-11-06 amendment still says §3 is unchanged and "is amended again for §3 then" (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H); the spec contract docs of `master_chain` and `master_reference_missing` do not mention the optional master. Card 3 (#30907) teaches the docs and skills.
- The verify proof covers the detail's own null master; the chain hop over a null-master middle row is pinned in the plugin-security suite only.
